settings.title: About the Nashua PAL Scholarship Fund
settings.description:
The Nashua PAL Scholarship Fund, in partnership with the Allard Family, was created to support local students who embody the values of sportsmanship, leadership, and academic excellence. Since its inception, the fund has awarded thousands of dollars in scholarships to graduating seniors from Nashua-area high schools.

Our scholarship recipients are selected based on their dedication to athletics, academics, community involvement, and personal character. We believe that investing in education is investing in the future of our community.

settings.tagline: Help us invest in the future of Nashua's youth through education.
